What is CC-CEDICT?
The word dictionary of this website is based on CC-CEDICT.

CC-CEDICT is a continuation of the CEDICT project started by Paul Denisowski in 1997 with the aim to provide a complete downloadable Chinese to English dictionary with pronunciation in pinyin for the Chinese characters.
This website allows you to easily add new entries or correct existing entries in CC-CEDICT.
Submitted entries will be checked and processed frequently and released for download in CEDICT format on this page.
The format of CC-CEDICT is described on the  CC-CEDICT Wiki .
